test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the compound interest on ₹20,000 for 9 months at the rate of 4% per annum, when interest is compounded quarterly?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Principal = Rs.20,000

Time = 9 months

Rate = 4% per annum

**FORMULA USED:**

C.I. = P × ( 1 +R/100)^t - P

Where P = Principal, R = Rate of interest, t = time and C.I. = Compound Interest.

**CALCULATION:**

Since the interest is compounded quarterly:

Rate = (4/4) = 1 %; Time = 9 × 4 = 36 months = 3 years 

Now, 

⇒ C.I. = 20,000 × ( 1 +1/100)³ - 20,000

⇒ C.I. = {20,000 × 101/100 × 101/100 × 101/100} - 20,000

⇒ C.I. = (20,000 ×1030301/1000000) - 20,000

⇒ C.I. = Rs.606.02.

**∴ The Compound interest is Rs.606.02.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Concept used:

Effective rate for 3 years at the rate of a% = 3a + (3a²/100) + a³/10000

**Calculation:**

Since the interest is compounded quarterly:

Rate = (4/4) = 1 %; Time = 9 × 4 = 36 months = 3 years 

Effective rate for 3 years at the rate of a% = 3 × 1 + (3 × 1/100) + 1/10000

⇒ 3 + 0.03 + 0.0001 = 3.0301 %

Now,

⇒ C.I = 20000 × 3.0301% 

⇒ C.I = Rs.606.02.

∴ The Compound interest is Rs.606.02.
